name: Behringer X32 / M32
author: Control It Team
subtitle: Digital Audio Mixing Console
descriptionText: Control channel mutes, faders, DCA groups, scene recalls, and main output on Behringer X32 and Midas M32 audio consoles via OSC/UDP.

setupFields.label: Console IP Address
setupFields.helpText: Enter the IP address of your X32/M32 console on the local network.

setupFields.label: OSC Port
setupFields.helpText: Default X32 OSC control port is 10023.

actions.title: X32: Mute Channel
actions.subtitle: Mute input channel
actions.descriptionText: Mutes designated audio input channel on the console.

actions.title: X32: Unmute Channel
actions.subtitle: Unmute input channel
actions.descriptionText: Unmutes designated audio input channel on the console.

actions.title: X32: Set Main LR Fader
actions.subtitle: Adjust master output volume
actions.descriptionText: Sets master stereo LR fader level (0.0 to 1.0).

actions.title: X32: Get Channel Mute Status
actions.subtitle: Query channel mute state
actions.descriptionText: Queries mute status for designated audio input channel on the console with live tally feedback.

actions.title: X32: Get Main LR Fader Level
actions.subtitle: Query master output volume
actions.descriptionText: Queries master stereo LR fader level with live level display.
